decision.title: The host shim's resolver, request and export files (packet )
decision.summary: The host shim's resolver is a state and a function in sxml_host_processor_configuration, each resource request names its processor, and the JavaScript exports are split over three files.

body.p: , after , , , , . Packet moved the JavaScript shim to bindings/host/ as the host shim (sxml_host_*, header bindings/host/sxml_host.h) and kept the JavaScript export names.

item.p: Resolver: sxml_host_resolver {void *state; uint32_t (*resolve)(void *state, const sxml_host_resource_request *, sxml_host_resource *)}, in sxml_host_processor_configuration {failing_allocation_number, feature_mask, resolver}. sxml_host_processor_create takes that configuration (one parameter). A NULL resolve makes no resource available, as the native fallback of the old import did.

Deviation: the request names its processor. sxml_host_resource_request gains a last field, : the processor that asks. A host copies its answer into memory from sxml_host_allocate on that processor, so every host needs it. The JavaScript import needs it too, because the package finds its processor state by that address. A resolver state cannot hold the processor, because the state is set before the processor exists. The struct is 6 words on wasm32 (was 5). The package reads only the first 5, so src/index.ts does not change.

p.strong: Deviation: three JavaScript files instead of two.

item.p: sxml_javascript_exports.c holds the exports of both modules.
sxml_javascript_full_exports.c holds the XQuery, XSLT and XSD exports. Only sxml-full.wasm links it, because the package tells the modules apart by those exports ().
sxml_javascript_host.c holds the resolver over the import sxml_host.resolve.
sxml_javascript.h declares them. Each export is a one-line wrapper of the host shim function with the same name.
sxml_host (static) is the shim with every feature of sxml_all_optional_features(): the library for Kotlin and Swift.
The object library sxml_host_core_features compiles the core features file natively, so that -Werror and lint check it.
The wasm modules link the host sources from the lists that bindings/host/CMakeLists.txt passes to the parent scope.
tests/host_shim_test.c is registered by the tests glob and gets sxml_host from bindings/host/CMakeLists.txt.

Size guard: test/size-baseline/sxml.txt renames the moved objects (__/host/sxml_host, __/host/sxml_host_core_features) and keeps the sizes of the audit. The guard then reports the move's real growth (+61), not a new object of 5,153 bytes.
Both are within the packet's 1 KB, and no budget changes.
